gen-eater-gf-radio-canada-big: Dark and snarling, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its thin strokes short of hairline. But Radio Canada Big is a monoline sans whose tall x-height fills the line, so a modest size is plenty.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hie: Audiowide looks like glyphs set as tiles with wide grout lines. It is best at joints that meet without thinning or bulging, while Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is best at a tall x-height with outward-pointing terminals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-odia: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary voice with a pronounced x-height and letters that never seem to pinch shut. Anek Odia echoes that openness, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook.
gen-eater-gf-roboto: Dark and aggressive, Eater sets wide gaps between letters and keeps ascenders short. Roboto has generous mouths on its round letters and a low capital-to-lowercase step, so paragraphs of text move along without snagging.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-radio-canada: Expressive and bold, Autour One leads each round letter in through a clear channel. And Radio Canada keeps a steady line with open curve endings, so paragraphs would flow without any pressure changes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-saira: Wide and commanding, Goldman stands its lowercase tall against the capitals, with round forms like open parentheses. And Saira, a sans, picks up that height, its rounded letters stretching toward the top line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sarpanch: Pipe-cleaner energy runs through Grandstander, with constant-width lines and short ascenders over a tall x-height. Sarpanch, a sans with a compact ascender gap and an open lowercase e, reins that in.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sen: Autour One is expressive and bold, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Sen, a sans whose lowercase is built tall and whose line never varies in weight, would carry paragraphs along easily.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sofia-sans: Reading here feels modern, with no stroke modulation and rounded letters left clearly open at the side. Sofia Sans stands its lowercase tall like cut acrylic stencil pieces, a natural partner for Grandstander and its constant-width lines.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Futuristic through and through, Audiowide holds its line width at every turn. Noto Sans Armenian, a sans-serif whose lowercase stands tall and full, with wide inviting round letters, would read comfortably paragraph after paragraph.
